### Introduction
You enter through a massive archway covered in shiny colored beads and silk curtains, passing through this gateway is like entering another world. The area is alive, people vibrantly dressed and celebrating, the place is packed with people covered head to toe in festival attire, tonight is a special night. A large wooden sign painted with crude and messy red paint says, "50GP BUY IN, MAKE SOME MONEY TONIGHT WITH, THE RHINO!!!"

The arena is a crude stone carved pit with a few layers. Inside sits a broken square of rope held up by wooden posts. It's basically just a stone pit for fighters to duke it out.

### The Market
The market is as vibrant as the people, with fanciful colored cloth roofed pop up shops selling delicious foods and trinkets of all kinds.

### The Pre-fight talk

As the party peruses the market a pair of orcs approach, clearly members of the Goldengloves as they have brass knuckles painted gold on their hands. They walk up to you smiling wickedly, the bigger one looks you all up and down with his arms crossed, "Mykoz wants a word wit ya. I ain't askin."

They are led up to the box seats through the locked metal door, there are at least 20 orcs with gold painted brass knuckles around you, and in a large throne made out of horns and claws sits a violently ripped orc. Its like bis biceps have biceps, his delts have delts, and his quads could shatter a +3 magic sword. 
He looks you up and down, only half interested as he watches the fight between an ogre and a dire bear below you in the Maw.
His henchmen tap him on the shoulder and he stands, at a staggering 5'6, his gigantic shoulders and arms striking fear into your hearts.

**Mykoz**:
- "So you wanna fight in my pit? You wanna show me who the baddest sons a bitches in the city are? Well fine by me, but if you die down there it aint on us get it?"
- "Yous are gonna need to give me your names, for the wavers."
- "See thats strange to me. Because one of my friends said they been lookin for you, he's fightin tonight. Goes by The RHINO, says he's been lookin for the metal man. Wanted to take his shot at Melantha too, but he lost the chance. You know him?"
- "The Rhino's a legend, champion of the blood circle, fought with Igan in the War for Liberation. They say he shattered some scales on Kagerra's dragon. Oh yeah, one of the most dangerous men to walk the world. Hey... you didn't hear this from me, but I heard he even turned down bein Vulcan's champion once... but that's just a myth, nothin to worry about I'm sure!"
- "I studied the greats, the conquerors, Lazarus, Agamar, Thaldrax. I know the way of pain, violence. I want blood tonight, yours or otherwise. Make the swords sing, sling some magic, just don't kill my spectators, they paid good money for this."
- "Oh and feel free to hit up the bookies, I wanna see my fighters get paid. Have fun down there Young Wolves, and feel free to take little breaks between fights. You dogs! Ahahahaha"

"Nothing else to say, get to work."

GOLD EARNED: 
### VALEN DRAKOVAR ARRIVES

During the second round of Fight 3, a violent screech echoes through the caverns, shaking the arena, and sending a few patrons on their way, in fear of what is coming.
Darksteel looks like he goes from putting on a show to locking in, his draconic eyes narrowing and focusing as he prepares for the real battle.
The Rhino seems unbothered.

During the fourth round, another violent screech, almost like a roar, shatters the ceiling at the top of the arena, two points of 10ft by 10ft have to make Dexterity saving throws in order to dodge the falling rocks and debris. (2d6 bludgeoning damage)

After the saves, you hear a vampiric laugh and you see the figure of a gigantic bat dragon, on its back the figure of Valen Drakovar. He laughs as the bat descends on the arena, intending to devour you.

Jerome readies himself, a glowing burning third eye appearing on his forehead. He draws a new sword, a silvered blade, and nods to you all. "You take the dragon, I can handle Drakovar."

Drakovar leaps from the back of Bloodwing, pointing his clawed hands at Jerome and they begin a duel. Bloodwing inches down towards you, frothing at the mount just getting close to you, its 8 beady red eyes fixed on all of you at once. 

The Rhino looks over at you and says, "I'd be more famous for killing that than killing you, call it even, split the corpse 50/50?"

#### Bloodwing is Thirsty

The Young Wolves + The Rhino versus Bloodwing. Jerome and Drakovar face off.

ENEMIES: [[vampiricRedDragon.jpg]]


### The Heirs to House Rex

After things get bad, Drakovar should die after 3 rounds, Darksteel returns to team up with the Young Wolves. They are in bad shape, down some people, things are rough.

Eventually Catherine Rex shows up and takes Bloodwing, inviting Antigone to join their family before its too late and the Young Wolves to die in style at Veinspire Castle, where she will be waiting. She leaves before things can escalate. 


### The Aftermath

As Bloodwing sinks its vampiric talons into the walls of the cave, the walls begin to crack and shatter, the rocks from the ceiling begin to fall s the arena starts to collapse around you all. 2 more 10ft by 10ft spots need to make Dexterity saving throws to not get crushed by rocks (2d6 bludgeoning damage). 

Jerome looks at Scarlett with fury in his eyes, and with a gigantic leap as his skin glows with fire he flies through the air, grabbing hold of the dragon and climbing onto its back chasing Scarlett as Bloodwing carries both of they away through the massive caverns.

The arena collapses and the tunnels where the market and leading up to the Maw are collapsing, they need to escape ASAP!

As you all gather yourselves, Barnabus Bear comes running towards you, terrified for his life! The Rhino looks around at you all and nods, "Live to fight another day." He charges towards the exit grabbing Barnabus in his arms, "Let's get you outta here little bear."
